description: This file contains code for creating and managing Kubernetes Deployment informers in version v1beta1, including functions to construct informers with optional filtering and context support, as well as interface and class definitions related to Deployment informers.

classes.name: deploymentInformer
classes.description: Implementation of the DeploymentInformer interface, managing shared informer factory, namespace, and list options.

methods.name: NewDeploymentInformer
methods.description: Creates a new shared informer for Deployment with default options.

methods.name: NewFilteredDeploymentInformer
methods.description: Creates a new shared informer for Deployment with filtering options.

methods.name: NewDeploymentInformerWithOptions
methods.description: Creates a new shared informer for Deployment with custom options.

methods.name: defaultInformer
methods.description: Returns the default shared index informer for the deployment.

methods.name: Informer
methods.description: Returns the shared index informer for Deployment.
